notes.title: Our new game + developer community links
notes.content:
Hello! We hope all has been well! We're here with with two bits of news:

1- If you're interesting in chatting it up with us, we've now got a Discord. We've got some new stuff cooking and we'll be sharing news, WIP art and videos, etc in our newly formed Robot Invader Discord server. We'll also be doing the occasional game giveaway and such there. If a newsletter or Twitter is more your thing, we're got those too. So if you're interesting in learning more about our previous games (we have 10!) and being the first to get info and opportunities to playtetst our next one (we're actively working on it!), plus game giveaways, we'd love for you to join our community. Here are the links:

 Robot Invader Discord server
 Robot Invader Newsletter (promise, no spam!)
 Twitter


2- our latest game SEEING THINGS recently launched! Woohoo!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/12663215/e74d964983935be9cf5a6368a433a8c28792c4f1.png

It's been a lot of fun seeing players and streamers alike enjoying SEEING THINGS. It's currently sitting at 100% positive reviews. And if it sounds like it's your thing --it's got the perfect blend of silly and spooky -- we'd love for you to check it out too!

notes.title: Beacon's Bluff 1.04 Update Released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679181/852c75f730069f5cfdc64deda5dccfc39b193622.gif
We've released Beacon's Bluff 1.04 Update for Windows and Mac OS!

This update fixes a crash bug experienced by some Windows users on certain graphics cards near the end game.  

It also includes the following improvements:

 More gameplay balancing and tuning.
 Significantly improved cutscene animations.
 Other minor bug fixes

The lighthouse needs keepers.  Get to it!

notes.title: Beacon's Bluff 1.03 Update Released
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43679181/bea116a128cf11c4eea06a48fe039753031611b3.gif
We've released Beacon's Bluff 1.03 Update for Windows and Mac OS!

This update includes the following improvements:

 Gameplay balancing based on user feedback.
 Improved cutscene animations.
 Fixes to a number of small bugs, including fades and game ending progression.
 Fixed a crash bug on retrying after death.

Keep the light burning.  Always!

notes.title: Stove Puzzle
notes.content:
First look at new puzzle

https://media1.giphy.com/media/bs20malKYHkuLEDCYD/giphy.gif

A rickety old stove sits in the shadows, its mouth agape, hungry for firewood. But, this fire-breathing beast is picky - the logs must be arranged in a very particular order (randomized each time). Watch closely. The ghostly whispers in the wind carry hints. Can you remember the order amidst the howls?

Beacon's Bluff launches later this month!
